Name: Flexible Cooking - Stardew Valley Expanded
Author: Kurila
Description:
This mod adjust the recipes from [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/3753]Stardew Valley Expanded[/url] to work with [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/38862]Flexible Cooking[/url].

Additional it has a config option to use the cooking chocolate from [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/6830]Love of Cooking[/url] for SVEs Chocolate Truffe Bar (makes sense, doesn't it?😉). Default is true
For using Chocolate fro the vanilla Chocolate Cake use [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/39607]Real Chocolate Cake[/url].

Manifest.Name: Flexible Cooking SVE
Manifest.Description: Adjust SVE recipes to work with Flexible Cooking
